title: TGT Social Science Teacher
subject: Social Science
shortDescription:
*Job Title: TGT Social Science (Master’s in Economics)*

*The Heritage School, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi*
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Department:* Social Science

Job Description

The Heritage School, Vasant Kunj, invites applications from qualified and dedicated educators for the position of Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – Social Science, with a postgraduate qualification in Economics.

The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering engaging, curriculum-aligned lessons, fostering critical thinking and developing students’ understanding of economic, historical, geographical and political concepts, as applicable to the assigned classes.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and deliver Social Science lessons in accordance with the CBSE curriculum and NCERT learning objectives.
* Explain economic concepts using real-world examples, case studies, current affairs and data interpretation.
* Develop students’ analytical thinking, research skills, civic awareness and problem-solving abilities.
* Use inquiry-based, experiential and interdisciplinary teaching strategies to enhance student engagement.
* Prepare lesson plans, worksheets, assignments, question papers and assessment materials.
* Assess learning outcomes, maintain academic records and provide constructive feedback.
* Support differentiated learning and address the diverse academic needs of students.
* Integrate appropriate digital resources, maps, graphs and other teaching-learning materials.
* Participate in departmental meetings, parent interactions, school activities and professional development programmes.
* Maintain a safe, inclusive and positive classroom environment.

Essential Qualifications

* *Master’s degree in Economics*, as required for this vacancy.
* Bachelor’s degree with the relevant subject combination required for TGT Social Science under the applicable recruitment rules.
* B.Ed. from a recognised institution, where prescribed.
* CTET Paper II qualification, where applicable under the relevant recruitment requirements.
* Candidates must satisfy the applicable CBSE, NCTE and Delhi school-teacher eligibility norms.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong subject knowledge in Economics and Social Science.
* Excellent communication and classroom facilitation skills.
* Ability to connect academic concepts with real-world developments.
* Competence in lesson planning, assessment design and student progress monitoring.
* Familiarity with CBSE/NCERT curriculum expectations and competency-based learning.
* Ability to promote critical thinking, collaboration and independent learning.

*Experience*

Relevant teaching experience in Social Science or Economics at the middle or secondary school level is preferred.

Work Location

The Heritage School, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may apply through Indeedor mail us on *careers.vk@theheritageschool.in* with an updated CV detailing their academic qualifications, teaching experience and relevant subject expertise.

*Please mention:* TGT Social Science – Master’s in Economics.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

To provide a warm, safe, and engaging environment that nurtures the holistic (social, emotional, cognitive, and physical) development of young children.

* *Parent Communication:* Build strong relationships with parents through daily updates, regular feedback on child progress, and parent-teacher meetings.
* *Progress Observation:* Track and record individual developmental milestones, tailoring support for children who need extra attention.

Participate in professional development opportunities to enhance teaching skills and stay updated on educational trends.

Plan and participate in extracurricular activities, such as clubs, field trips, and special events.

title: School Calling Executive
subject: Administration / Operations
shortDescription:
We are looking for a confident, motivated, and professional *School Calling Executive* who will contact schools, communicate with principals and HR representatives, collect current job vacancies, and develop long-term relationships with educational institutions.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a professional telephone manner, and the ability to persuade schools to share their recruitment requirements with EduHire360.com.

Key Responsibilities

* *School Calling and Outreach*
* Make 80–100 outbound calls daily to schools using company-provided contact lists.
* Contact school principals, HR managers, administrators, and management representatives.
* Introduce EduHire360.com and explain how our recruitment services help schools find suitable teaching staff.
* *Collecting Job Vacancies*
* Identify current and upcoming vacancies for PRT, TGT, PGT, NTT, Principal, Vice Principal, and other teaching positions.
* Collect vacancies for JEE/NEET faculty, academic coordinators, librarians, clerks, accountants, and other non-teaching roles.
* Record essential details such as subject, qualification, experience, salary range, location, and application procedure.
* Confirm that vacancies are genuine and currently active before submitting them.
* *Building School Relationships*
* Develop professional relationships with school management and HR teams.
* Encourage schools to share their recruitment requirements regularly.
* Follow up with schools regarding new vacancies, pending information, and interview schedules.
* Maintain a database of active, inactive, and prospective school partners.
* *Coordination and Follow-Up*
* Coordinate with the teacher recruitment team to match suitable candidates with school requirements.
* Share relevant candidate profiles with schools through approved company processes.
* Follow up on applications, interview invitations, candidate feedback, and hiring outcomes.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, responses, commitments, and next follow-up dates.
* *Reporting and Performance Tracking*
* Update the CRM, spreadsheet, or company database after every call.
* Submit daily reports covering calls made, schools contacted, decision-makers reached, vacancies collected, and follow-ups completed.
* Work toward weekly and monthly targets for active school partnerships and verified vacancies.

Daily Performance TargetsPerformance MetricDaily TargetOutbound calls80–100Meaningful conversations15–25Schools providing vacancy informationTarget set after initial trainingFollow-upsBased on pending leadsCRM/database updates100% of calls

_Targets may be adjusted based on call quality, school response rates, territory, and the quality of the contact database._

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum qualification: 12th pass; graduation preferred.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable speaking with principals, HR managers, and school administrators.
* Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in spreadsheets or CRM software.
* Ability to handle rejection professionally and follow up consistently.
* Organized, punctual, target-oriented, and willing to learn.
* Prior experience in telecalling, sales, customer support, or education recruitment is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of quality calls and meaningful conversations.
* Number of genuine, verified vacancies collected.
* Number of schools actively sharing vacancies.
* Accuracy and completeness of vacancy information.
* Follow-up discipline and database quality.
* Growth in repeat school partnerships and successful candidate referrals.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with an education-focused recruitment platform.
* Training on school outreach, vacancy collection, and recruitment coordination.
* Performance-based incentives, where applicable.
* Opportunity to grow into School Relationship Executive, Team Leader, or Recruitment Business Development roles.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

1. Job Purpose

To deliver effective, engaging, and concept-based Mathematics instruction that develops students’ logical reasoning, analytical thinking, numerical proficiency, and problem-solving abilities in alignment with the CBSE curriculum and the school's academic standards.

2. Key Responsibilities

*A. Teaching & Academic Delivery*

* Plan and deliver structured Mathematics lessons in accordance with the prescribed CBSE curriculum.
* Explain mathematical concepts using practical examples, activities, demonstrations, and real-life applications.
* Develop students’ conceptual understanding, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
* Prepare lesson plans, worksheets, assignments, question banks, and teaching-learning materials.
* Incorporate appropriate digital tools, smart classroom resources, and innovative teaching methodologies.
* Address the learning needs of students with different academic abilities.

*B. Assessment & Performance Management*

* Conduct regular class tests, assignments, quizzes, and examinations.
* Evaluate answer sheets and maintain accurate records of students’ academic performance.
* Analyse assessment results and implement remedial measures wherever required.
* Provide constructive feedback and additional academic support to students.
* Prepare progress reports and contribute to academic reviews as required.

*C. Classroom Management & Student Development*

* Maintain discipline and create a positive, inclusive, and student-friendly learning environment.
* Encourage student participation, curiosity, confidence, and independent thinking.
* Identify learning gaps and provide appropriate guidance and mentoring.
* Promote academic integrity, responsible behaviour, and effective study habits.

*D. Curriculum Planning & Coordination*

* Complete the prescribed syllabus within the academic calendar.
* Coordinate with the HOD and fellow teachers for curriculum planning and academic activities.
* Participate in departmental meetings, workshops, training sessions, and school events.
* Contribute to Mathematics Olympiads, quizzes, exhibitions, competitions, and other enrichment activities, as assigned.

*E. Parent Communication & Documentation*

* Communicate students’ academic progress and areas for improvement to parents.
* Attend parent-teacher meetings and academic review sessions.
* Maintain lesson plans, attendance records, assessment data, and other academic documentation.
* Follow school policies, CBSE guidelines, child-safeguarding requirements, and institutional procedures.

3. Educational Qualifications

* M.Sc. with Mathematics.
* B.Ed. from a recognized institution, as applicable to the teaching level and recruitment requirements.
* M.Ed. in Mathematics will be an added advantage.
* CTET / TET qualification, wherever applicable to the position and relevant recruitment norms.

4. Experience

* Relevant teaching experience in Mathematics at a CBSE-affiliated school is preferred.
* Experience teaching the relevant grade levels and preparing students for school examinations is desirable.
* Candidates with strong subject knowledge, communication skills, and effective classroom management abilities may also be considered in accordance with school requirements.

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong command of Mathematics and its practical applications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Effective classroom management and student-engagement techniques.
* Lesson planning, assessment design, and academic performance analysis.
* Proficiency in digital teaching tools and MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Patience, adaptability, teamwork, and a student-centric approach.
* Ability to motivate students and explain complex concepts in a simple manner.

6. Key Result Areas (KRAs)

* *Academic Delivery:* Effective completion of assigned teaching periods and planned lessons.
* *Syllabus Completion:* Timely completion of the prescribed syllabus as per the academic calendar.
* *Student Performance:* Improvement in conceptual understanding and assessment outcomes.
* *Assessment & Feedback:* Timely evaluation, feedback, and maintenance of academic records.
* *Classroom Management:* Maintenance of discipline and an engaging learning environment.
* *Student Support:* Identification of learning gaps and implementation of remedial teaching.
* *Professional Development:* Active participation in training, departmental meetings, and academic initiatives.
* *Policy Compliance:* Adherence to school policies, academic standards, and applicable CBSE requirements.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Percentage of syllabus completed within the scheduled timeline.
* Student performance in periodic tests and examinations.
* Improvement in student learning outcomes against established academic targets.
* Timeliness and accuracy of assessment and academic documentation.
* Effectiveness of remedial teaching and support initiatives.
* Classroom observation and teaching-quality feedback.
* Timely completion of lesson plans, assignments, and academic responsibilities.
* Feedback from students, parents, and academic leadership, as applicable.

8. Personal Attributes

* Professional, ethical, and student-focused.
* Enthusiastic about teaching and continuous learning.
* Responsible, organised, punctual, and committed to academic excellence.
* Capable of working collaboratively with the academic team.

9. Application Process

SUBJECTS: Science Teacher CBSE (TGT)

MUST HAVE B.ED

The roles and responsibilities of a school teacher can vary depending on grade level, subject, and school policies, but here are some common core duties and expectations:

*Instructional Planning*: Teachers are responsible for designing and delivering effective lesson plans that align with curriculum standards. They must adapt their teaching methods to accommodate diverse learning styles and abilities.

*Classroom Management*: Maintaining a positive and orderly classroom environment is crucial. Teachers must establish rules and expectations, manage student behavior, and address any disruptions that may arise.

*Assessment and Evaluation*: Teachers assess student performance through various means such as tests, quizzes, projects, and assignments. They analyze and use assessment data to track student progress and adjust instruction as needed.

*Curriculum Development*: In addition to lesson planning, teachers may have a role in developing or revising curriculum materials to meet the needs of their students and keep up with educational standards.

*Individualized Instruction*: Recognizing that students have different learning needs, teachers should provide additional support or challenges as required. This includes working with students who have special needs or require differentiated instruction.

*Communication*: Teachers communicate regularly with students, parents, and colleagues. They provide feedback on student progress, discuss concerns, and attend parent-teacher conferences and meetings.

*Professional Development*: Continuous learning is essential for teachers. They should engage in ongoing professional development to stay current with educational trends, teaching methods, and subject matter.

*Supervision and Safety*: Ensuring the safety and well-being of students is a top priority. Teachers must supervise students in and outside of the classroom and follow safety protocols.

*Collaboration*: Teachers often work as part of a team, collaborating with other educators, specialists, and support staff to address the diverse needs of their students.

*Counseling and Support*: Teachers sometimes act as mentors and provide emotional support to students who may be facing challenges at home or in their personal lives.

*Record-Keeping*: Maintaining accurate records of student attendance, grades, and other relevant information is essential for monitoring progress and complying with administrative requirements.

*Professional Ethics*: Teachers are expected to adhere to a code of professional ethics, which includes respecting student confidentiality, maintaining appropriate boundaries, and upholding the values of fairness and equity in their teaching practices.

*Community Involvement*: Engaging with the local community and participating in school events, clubs, or extracurricular activities can be part of a teacher's responsibilities.

*Technology Integration*: In today's digital age, teachers are often expected to incorporate technology into their teaching methods and use it for communication and instructional purposes.

*Cultural Sensitivity*: Being aware of and respecting cultural and diversity issues in the classroom is crucial for creating an inclusive learning environment.

title: Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)
description:
Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)
THE ROLE

Own test strategy, quality architecture, and the automated regression infrastructure for Securly Flex — the flex period scheduling and attendance platform that 1,000+ schools use every school day to place students into intervention, enrichment, and support sessions.

Flex decides where students are supposed to be. A defect in Autoassign placement, capacity limits, separation rules, roster sync, or attendance recording does not just break a feature — it can put a student in the wrong room, leave a must-attend intervention empty, place students together who are required to be kept apart, or send inaccurate attendance into a district's student information system. The test infrastructure you build is the last line of defense before production.

This is an engineering leadership role, not a QA role. You will define what "production-ready" means for Flex, build the automation platform that enforces it through CI/CD quality gates, and write production-quality code for that platform yourself. You will also serve as the team's expert on rules-engine correctness and edge-case testing — your understanding of how Flex's rules interact (priorities, capacity limits, restricted sessions, sign-up cutoffs, and check-in controls) directly shapes both the test suite and the implementation team's design decisions.

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid – 2 days onsite)
Experience: 6–10+ years
Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Own the quality bar. Define what "passing" means for Flex: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases.
Test the rules engine. Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic — student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten — plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries.
Gate every release. Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory.
Set performance baselines. Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each flex period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression.
Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on Flex runs on with Securly Pass.
Build the framework. Architect and build the Flex automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends — and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability.
Mentor and scale. Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage.
Shape architecture. Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad.
Own incidents. Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS
Must-Have
Test framework architecture — designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts.
Test automation (SDET-level) — Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior — placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions — not just UI interaction tests.
CI/CD quality gates — integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1,000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it.
Rules-engine and data-integrity testing — designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits.
Strong programming — JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code.
Technical communication — ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on.
Education & experience — Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience.
Strongly Preferred
Performance & concurrency testing — k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs.
AI-assisted test engineering — using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams.
Security & access-control testing — role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations.
Nice to Have
Mobile test automation — Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage.
Integration testing — SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push).
K-12 EdTech domain — understanding of bell schedules, flex and advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios.
WHO YOU ARE
You test the edge cases, not just the happy path. You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them.
You have built automation frameworks from the ground up — not just inherited them — and other engineers have built on what you designed.
You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline. A feature without a regression suite is not finished — and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments.
You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release.
You are hands-on at a senior level — you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you. Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement.
Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions. Your influence extends past your own work.
You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec.
ABOUT SECURLY

Tech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact.

Securly processes over 1.1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K–12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement.

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in student safety and wellbeing at scale.

We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills.

description:
Institutional Outreach & Partnerships Consultant – Schools & Colleges

*Retired Teachers, Headmasters, Principals and College Faculty Encouraged to Apply*

*Company:* OfEd — developed by Gigly AI.
*Location:* Chennai, with visits to schools and colleges across assigned nearby areas
*Work mode:* Field-based
*Experience:* Teaching, academic leadership, educational publishing, or institutional sales experience preferred
*Compensation:* Based on experience; proposed structure includes fixed pay, sales incentives, and travel reimbursement
*Website:* https://ofed.app

About OfEd

OfEd is an educational publishing and engagement platform that helps schools and colleges connect learning, practice, academic publishing, and student portfolios.

For schools, our offerings include NEET preparation books, previous-year question banks, and school-specific editions with QR-linked access to digital learning and practice. OfEd supports teachers in guiding students through learning, practice, correction, and revision.

For colleges, OfEd enables departments to manage faculty-led assignments, review student submissions, and publish approved work. Students build portfolios through academic work reviewed by their faculty. Submissions remain private to the relevant faculty and students until approved for public publishing.

Our work includes supporting departmental academic publishing and student portfolios at Madras Christian College (MCC), Chennai, including its Journalism department.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced educator or institutional sales professional to introduce OfEd to schools and colleges, build relationships with decision-makers, and convert suitable opportunities into book orders and platform adoption.

You will meet school correspondents, principals, headmasters, college leaders, heads of departments, academic coordinators, and faculty. The role combines institutional outreach, product presentations, commercial follow-up, and coordination with the OfEd team.

Retired educators who wish to continue contributing to education through institutional engagement are encouraged to apply. Relevant teaching and leadership experience will be valued alongside sales experience.

Key Responsibilities

*Institutional outreach and relationship development*

* Identify and approach suitable schools and colleges within the assigned territory.
* Schedule meetings with institutional leaders, department heads, and faculty.
* Understand each institution’s academic priorities, student needs, and existing practices.
* Build relationships through regular communication and timely follow-up.

*School books and digital learning*

* Present OfEd educational books, NEET preparation resources, previous-year question banks, and digital learning features.
* Explain school-specific editions, branding options, and QR-linked learning and practice.
* Arrange sample-book presentations and coordinate demonstrations with the OfEd team.
* Follow up on quotations, bulk orders, and repeat requirements.
* Coordinate school names, branding details, QR codes, quantities, and delivery requirements with internal teams.

*College publishing and student portfolios*

* Introduce departmental publishing, faculty-led assignments, and student portfolio use cases.
* Explain how faculty review, revision, and approval help students develop publishable academic work.
* Coordinate demonstrations and discussions with interested departments.
* Support follow-up on proposals, initial implementation, and opportunities for wider institutional adoption.

*Sales coordination and onboarding*

* Work with the OfEd team to prepare proposals and quotations.
* Follow up on decisions, order confirmations, and payments.
* Maintain accurate records of visits, opportunities, orders, collections, and next steps.
* Coordinate initial teacher and faculty onboarding.
* Share institutional feedback to improve OfEd’s books, platform, and support.

Candidate Profile

We welcome applicants from either of these backgrounds:

* *Education:* Teachers, headmasters, principals, college faculty, heads of departments, or academic coordinators with an interest in institutional outreach.
* *Sales:* Professionals experienced in educational books, publishing, school or college sales, ERP/LMS solutions, or other institutional education services.

Candidates should have:

* Strong communication and presentation skills in Tamil and English.
* Confidence engaging with institutional leaders and faculty.
* Willingness to make regular field visits within the assigned territory.
* Consistent follow-up, organisation, and relationship-management skills.
* Comfort using smartphones, email, spreadsheets, and basic digital platforms.
* Willingness to learn OfEd’s offerings and demonstrate their practical use.
* Readiness to work towards agreed outreach, sales, and adoption goals.

Existing school or college relationships are an advantage. Familiarity with NEET preparation, Tamil Nadu State Board, CBSE, or college academic workflows is helpful.

A two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred for local travel.

*Prior sales experience is not essential for educators who can demonstrate strong institutional relationships, communication skills, and willingness to undertake sales and follow-up responsibilities.*

What Success Looks Like

* Productive meetings with relevant school and college decision-makers.
* Clear demonstrations that connect OfEd’s offerings to institutional needs.
* Conversion of suitable opportunities into paid book orders and agreed platform adoption.
* Accurate coordination of customised editions, deliveries, and onboarding.
* Strong relationships that lead to repeat orders, departmental expansion, and referrals.

How to Apply

Apply through Naukri with your updated CV. Please include:

* Your current location and the areas you can cover.
* Your experience in education, academic leadership, publishing, or institutional sales.
* The types of schools, colleges, or departments you have worked with.
* Your availability to join and expected compensation.

*Key Skills:* Institutional Outreach, School Partnerships, College Partnerships, Educational Publishing, Book Sales, Institutional Sales, Field Sales, Business Development, Academic Coordination, Faculty Engagement, Digital Learning, NEET, Tamil, Relationship Management.

title: Vice Principal
description:
Job Title: Vice Principal

*Reporting To:* Principal
*Curriculum:* ICSE
*Location:* Universal School, Chembur

Objective

To support the Principal in the effective leadership and management of the school, ensuring academic excellence, smooth day-to-day operations, effective implementation of the ICSE curriculum, staff development, student well-being, and adherence to CISCE guidelines and school policies.

The Vice Principal will act as the second-in-command to the Principal and ensure consistency in academic delivery, discipline, operational efficiency, and the overall quality of the teaching-learning environment.

Key ResponsibilitiesA. Academic Leadership and Curriculum Management

* Ensure effective implementation of the ICSE curriculum across applicable grades.
* Monitor lesson planning, syllabus completion, classroom teaching, and learning outcomes.
* Conduct regular classroom observations and provide constructive feedback to teachers.
* Review assessment plans, question papers, examination schedules, and result analysis.
* Track students' academic progress and implement remedial and enrichment programmes.
* Ensure appropriate preparation for ICSE board examinations, where applicable.
* Promote innovative teaching methodologies, experiential learning, and technology integration.

B. Staff Management and Development

* Supervise teachers, coordinators, and academic support staff.
* Support teacher recruitment, induction, mentoring, and performance evaluation.
* Identify training needs and coordinate professional development programmes.
* Monitor teacher attendance, punctuality, lesson plans, and classroom effectiveness.
* Address staff concerns, interpersonal issues, and performance gaps in consultation with the Principal.
* Build a collaborative, accountable, and student-focused teaching team.

C. Student Discipline and Well-being

* Establish and maintain a positive, safe, and disciplined school environment.
* Monitor student attendance, behaviour, punctuality, and academic engagement.
* Address disciplinary issues fairly and consistently in line with school policies.
* Support counselling, inclusion, and student welfare initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with child protection and student safeguarding procedures.
* Coordinate with counsellors, parents, and relevant staff to resolve student concerns.

D. School Administration and Operations

* Oversee daily school functioning, including timetables, assemblies, examinations, and school events.
* Ensure effective utilisation of classrooms, laboratories, libraries, and other facilities.
* Coordinate substitution arrangements and deployment of teaching staff.
* Monitor adherence to school policies, administrative procedures, and reporting timelines.
* Support the Principal in inspections, audits, documentation, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with transport, security, housekeeping, facilities, and other support teams as required.

E. Parent and Stakeholder Engagement

* Address parent concerns professionally and within defined timelines.
* Conduct parent meetings and support effective communication regarding student progress.
* Resolve escalated academic and behavioural concerns in consultation with the Principal.
* Build positive relationships with parents, teachers, and the wider school community.
* Represent the school at meetings and events when delegated by the Principal.

F. Compliance, Safety and Governance

* Support adherence to applicable CISCE requirements and school policies.
* Ensure timely and accurate academic records, student documentation, and examination records.
* Monitor implementation of child safeguarding, health, hygiene, fire safety, and emergency procedures.
* Support readiness for inspections, audits, and regulatory reviews.
* Escalate significant incidents, risks, and compliance gaps to the Principal promptly.

G. Strategic Planning and School Improvement

* Assist the Principal in developing and implementing the school's academic improvement plan.
* Analyse student performance, teacher effectiveness, attendance, and parent feedback.
* Identify areas for improvement and implement measurable corrective actions.
* Support initiatives related to student enrolment, parent satisfaction, school reputation, and retention.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and institutional accountability.

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to share their updated CV at *samiksha.dubey@universal.edu.in*.

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

description:
Consultant Trainer – Foundational Learning, English Language, Pedagogy & Technology
About Kotak Education Foundation
Kotak Education Foundation (KEF) works towards improving the quality of education by strengthening teachers, school leaders and education systems.
We are looking for experienced Consultant Trainers to deliver high-quality teacher training programmes across Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh and Gujarat.

Role Purpose
The Consultant Trainer will be responsible for facilitating high-quality, engaging and practice-oriented training programmes for teachers and education stakeholders across the assigned state.
The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in teacher education and classroom pedagogy, with relevant experience in at least one of the following domains:
Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)
English Language Learning and Acquisition
Pedagogy
Use of Technology in Education
The role also requires the ability to contextualise training to the language, curriculum and classroom realities of the respective state.

Key Responsibilities
1. Teacher Training & Facilitation
Deliver face-to-face and, where required, virtual training programmes for teachers and education stakeholders.
Facilitate training sessions using participatory, experiential and activity-based methodologies.
Conduct demonstrations, modelling sessions, practice activities, teach-backs and reflection sessions.
Create an environment that encourages teacher participation, discussion and application.
Adapt facilitation approaches based on participant profiles, school contexts and learning needs.
Support teachers in translating training concepts into classroom practice.
2. Domain Expertise
The Consultant Trainer should have demonstrated experience in at least one of the following domains:
A. Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)
Foundational literacy and numeracy concepts and classroom practices.
Early-grade language and mathematics pedagogy.
Play-based, activity-based and experiential approaches.
Reading, writing, oral language and foundational mathematics.
Classroom assessment and identification of learning gaps.
Familiarity with NIPUN Bharat / foundational learning objectives will be an advantage.
B. English Language Learning & Acquisition
English language teaching and language acquisition.
Teaching English in multilingual classroom contexts.
Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing (LSRW).
Communicative language teaching and learner-centred pedagogy.
Vocabulary, grammar and reading development.
Understanding of language acquisition principles.
Familiarity with CEFR or other language proficiency frameworks will be an advantage.
C. Pedagogy
Strong understanding of effective teaching-learning practices.
Learner-centred and activity-based pedagogy.
Experiential and inquiry-based learning.
Differentiated instruction and inclusive classroom practices.
Lesson planning, classroom management and assessment.
Ability to translate pedagogical theories into practical classroom strategies.
D. Use of Technology in Education
Integration of technology into teaching and learning.
Digital pedagogy and technology-enabled classroom practices.
Use of digital tools and platforms for teaching, learning and assessment.
Ability to demonstrate technology tools to teachers with varying levels of digital proficiency.
Familiarity with AI-enabled educational tools will be an advantage.
3. Training Preparation & Design
Study training manuals, facilitator guides, presentations and supporting resources before delivery.
Prepare for training through dry runs, practice and self-learning.
Provide feedback on training materials based on field experience.
Adapt examples and activities to local classroom contexts without compromising programme objectives.
Support the CCT team in developing or refining training resources when required.
4. Field Implementation
Travel extensively within the assigned state to conduct teacher training programmes.
Work across urban, semi-urban and rural locations as required.
Coordinate with project teams, school leaders and field teams to ensure smooth training delivery.
Maintain professional conduct and represent KEF appropriately at partner and beneficiary locations.
Demonstrate flexibility regarding training locations, schedules and participant groups.
5. Documentation & Quality Assurance
Maintain accurate records of trainings conducted, participant attendance and training-related data.
Complete training reports and feedback documentation within stipulated timelines.
Collect and communicate field-level observations, challenges and success stories.
Use participant feedback and observation data to improve subsequent training delivery.
Adhere to KEF's training quality standards and processes.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience
Essential Qualifications
B.Ed. is mandatory.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education, English, Psychology, Mathematics or a related discipline will be preferred.
Additional qualifications/certifications in teacher training, instructional design, FLN, English language teaching or educational technology will be an advantage.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in classroom teaching, teacher training, academic mentoring or a related education role.
Demonstrated experience in at least ONE of the following domains is mandatory:
Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)
English Language Learning and Acquisition
Pedagogy
Use of Technology in Education
Experience in more than one of these domains will be an advantage.
Experience facilitating training for teachers is preferred.
Candidates with a combination of classroom teaching and teacher training experience will be preferred.

Language Requirements
Fluency in relevant state language is mandatory.
The candidate must be comfortable conducting teacher training, explaining concepts, facilitating discussions and responding to participant questions in the local language.

Geography-Specific Requirements
Maharashtra
Mandatory:
B.Ed.
Minimum 5 years relevant experience.
Experience in at least one of the four domains: FLN, English Language Learning & Acquisition, Pedagogy or Use of Technology.
Fluency in Marathi and English.
Willingness to travel extensively across Maharashtra.
Preferred: Experience with government schools, Marathi-medium/multilingual classrooms, NIPUN Bharat/FLN initiatives, SCERT/DIET or education department programmes.

Vidyāmṛt offers an opportunity to contribute to an evolving educational model that seeks to combine academic excellence with character, creativity, innovation, and spiritual development.

The role is suited to someone who wants to do more than administrative work: someone who enjoys building systems, coordinating people, solving problems, and helping an educational vision translate into meaningful daily experiences for children.

title: Business Development Officer – Healthcare & Medical Education (CPD Courses)
description:
Job Title: Business Development Officer – Healthcare & Medical Education (CPD Courses)

*Job Type:* Full-time
*Work Mode:* Work from Office + Field Visits
*Department:* Business Development & Institutional Sales
*Experience Required:* 2–5 Years
*Industry Preference:* Healthcare, Medical Education, Pharmaceutical Sales, Medical Training, or Institutional Business Development
*Location:* Hyderabad, Telangana
*Salary:* Competitive salary based on experience + Performance-Based Incentives

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, target-oriented, and experienced *Business Development Officer (BDO)* with a strong background in the medical and healthcare industry to drive business growth for our Continuing Professional Development (CPD) courses.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience in business development, institutional sales, healthcare partnerships, or medical education, with a proven ability to generate business from hospitals, clinics, medical colleges, nursing colleges, pharmacy colleges, and other healthcare-related institutions.

This is a field-oriented business development role that requires regular visits to healthcare institutions, building relationships with key decision-makers, promoting our CPD training programmes, developing institutional partnerships, and converting business opportunities into confirmed enrolments and revenue.

*We are specifically looking for someone who knows how to bring business to the company, has experience in the medical sector, and can independently develop new institutional accounts.*

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Revenue Generation

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for CPD courses and healthcare-related training programmes.
* Generate qualified leads and convert them into paying institutional clients and course enrolments.
* Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Build a strong pipeline of hospitals, clinics, colleges, and healthcare institutions.
* Negotiate commercial terms, training packages, and institutional enrolment opportunities.
* Take ownership of the complete business development cycle, from prospecting to deal closure.

2. Hospital & Healthcare Institution Visits

* Conduct regular field visits to hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres, healthcare groups, and other medical institutions.
* Meet hospital administrators, medical superintendents, HR managers, training coordinators, nursing superintendents, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Present CPD courses and explain their relevance to doctors, nurses, pharmacists, nutrition professionals, and other healthcare practitioners.
* Explore opportunities for institutional training programmes, bulk enrolments, staff development initiatives, and recurring training partnerships.
* Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospective and existing institutional clients to convert opportunities into business.

3. Medical College & Educational Institution Partnerships

* Develop business relationships with:
* MBBS colleges and medical schools
* Nursing colleges and nursing schools
* B.Sc. Nutrition and Dietetics colleges
* Pharmacy colleges
* Allied health sciences and paramedical institutions
* Healthcare training institutes and professional associations
* Visit college management teams, principals, deans, heads of departments, placement officers, and faculty coordinators.
* Promote CPD courses to relevant institutions and identify suitable opportunities for student, faculty, and professional enrolments, where applicable.
* Arrange institutional presentations, meetings, seminars, orientation sessions, and course awareness activities.
* Establish long-term partnerships with colleges and healthcare institutions to generate repeat business.

4. Institutional Sales & Partnership Development

* Pitch CPD programmes to hospitals, colleges, clinics, and healthcare organisations.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations, and partnership offers for prospective clients.
* Explore bulk enrolment models, corporate training opportunities, institutional tie-ups, and customised training arrangements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to organise course demonstrations, information sessions, and enrolment drives.
* Identify new market segments and geographical areas for expanding the company's healthcare education business.

5. Lead Management & Client Relationship Management

* Maintain an updated database of prospects, institutional contacts, meetings, and sales opportunities.
* Track leads, follow-ups, proposals, negotiations, enrolments, and revenue generated.
* Use CRM tools or structured reporting systems to manage the sales pipeline.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat enrolments and referrals.
* Submit daily activity reports and periodic business development reports to management.

6. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Research hospitals, medical colleges, nursing institutions, pharmacy colleges, and other potential clients.
* Identify institutions with suitable training requirements and potential demand for CPD courses.
* Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and institutional training needs.
* Provide feedback to management regarding customer expectations, pricing opportunities, and potential new programmes.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare Management, Nursing, or a related discipline is preferred.
* *Minimum 2 years of relevant experience* in healthcare business development, pharmaceutical sales, medical education sales, institutional sales, or healthcare partnership development.
* Prior experience generating revenue or bringing business to a company within the medical or healthcare sector is essential.
* Experience dealing with hospitals, clinics, medical colleges, nursing colleges, pharmacy colleges, or healthcare institutions is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to identify prospects, meet decision-makers, develop relationships, negotiate, and close deals.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly for institutional visits and business meetings.
* Ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and achieve assigned business targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate may have experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Pharmaceutical or medical product sales with strong institutional contacts.
* Hospital business development or corporate healthcare sales.
* Medical education, healthcare training, or CPD programme sales.
* Business development for nursing, pharmacy, allied health sciences, or medical colleges.
* Institutional partnerships, academic collaborations, or healthcare training contracts.
* Selling professional training programmes, certification courses, or educational services to healthcare organisations.

*Candidates with an existing network of hospital administrators, doctors, nursing college management, pharmacy college management, or medical education professionals will have an advantage.*

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against clearly defined business development objectives, including:

* Number of new hospitals, clinics, and educational institutions approached.
* Number of qualified leads and decision-maker meetings generated.
* Number of institutional partnerships established.
* Number of proposals submitted and deals successfully closed.
* CPD course enrolments generated through institutional channels.
* Monthly and quarterly revenue achieved against assigned targets.
* Conversion rate from qualified leads to confirmed business.
* Quality of client relationships, follow-up discipline, and repeat business.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and industry knowledge.
* Performance-based incentives linked to business generated.
* Opportunity to develop a strong network across the healthcare and medical education sectors.
* A growth-oriented role with direct responsibility for institutional partnerships and revenue generation.
* Opportunity to contribute to professional development and continuing education within the healthcare sector.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance and business impact.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who have relevant healthcare industry experience and a proven track record in business development are encouraged to apply.

Please highlight the following in your application:

* Previous healthcare or medical industry experience.
* Hospitals, clinics, colleges, or institutions handled.
* Experience in institutional sales and partnership development.
* Examples of business generated, sales targets achieved, or major accounts acquired.
* Current location, notice period, and expected salary.

*Important:* This is a business development and revenue-generation position, not a purely administrative or telecalling role. Candidates must be comfortable with field visits, institutional meetings, client relationship management, and achieving sales targets.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

*Location:* Pune, Maharashtra
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Program:* Lighthouse Kiran
*Reports To:* Senior Manager
*Travel Requirement:* Up to 70%
*Experience: 8+ years*

About Lighthouse Communities Foundation

Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF) works to create pathways to *education, skilling, employment, and sustainable livelihoods for underserved youth*.

Through a pioneering Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, LCF brings together *Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Citizens* to create opportunities and enable socio-economic transformation.

Our Lighthouse centres are supported through partnerships with government and corporate CSR stakeholders, while NGOs bring expertise in education and skilling to create meaningful opportunities for young people.

With a strong presence across Pune and expansion across *PCMC, Dombivli, Aurangabad, Delhi, Odisha, Hyderabad, Thane, and other geographies*, we continue to build scalable models for youth development.

*Our core values:* Empathy | Inclusion | Integrity | Courage

*About Lighthouse Kiran*

*Lighthouse Kiran* focuses on helping adolescents develop the skills, confidence, and agency needed to make informed decisions about their education, personal development, and future livelihoods.

The program focuses strongly on *Social and Emotional Learning (SEL)* and aims to create learning environments where adolescents feel secure, supported, and empowered to take ownership of their learning.

Through SEL, teacher capacity building, improved learning environments, and stronger educational engagement, Lighthouse Kiran seeks to:

* Strengthen adolescents' core competencies and agency.
* Develop self-learning, creativity, and decision-making skills.
* Support positive academic and social development.
* Reduce school dropout rates.
* Improve students' preparedness for future education and livelihoods.

*About the Role*

We are looking for an experienced and purpose-driven *Manager – Quality Education* to lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the Lighthouse Kiran program.

The role will involve managing program implementation across *Pune, Pimpri Chinchwad, Hyderabad, Odisha, and Thane*, as well as supporting expansion into tribal locations and other geographies.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in *education program management, Social Emotional Learning, teacher development, stakeholder engagement, impact measurement, and team leadership*.

The role requires the ability to work closely with schools, government departments, teachers, community stakeholders, donors, and internal teams to ensure high-quality implementation and measurable outcomes.

*Key Responsibilities*

1. Program Implementation & Monitoring

* Lead the implementation of Lighthouse Kiran across programme locations and partner institutions.
* Coordinate with field teams, schools, colleges, and institutional partners to ensure effective program delivery.
* Monitor learner participation, program quality, implementation progress, and intended outcomes.
* Strengthen engagement with adolescents, teachers, school leaders, and institutional stakeholders.
* Identify implementation challenges and develop timely solutions.
* Support the design and piloting of innovative interventions to strengthen program outcomes.

2. Impact Assessment, Monitoring & Learning

* Design and implement impact assessment and learning frameworks for Lighthouse Kiran.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative program data.
* Track key program indicators and identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Generate actionable insights and recommendations for continuous program improvement.
* Prepare impact reports and present findings to internal teams, donors, government stakeholders, and partners.

3. Teacher Capacity Building

Design, coordinate, and facilitate capacity-building initiatives for:

* Primary and secondary school teachers.
* Headmasters/Headmistresses.
* School leaders and other education stakeholders.

Key areas may include:

* Social Emotional Learning (SEL).
* Assessment for Learning.
* Positive School Climate.
* Adolescent development and well-being.
* Learner-centred teaching practices.

4. Government & Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain strong working relationships with:

* Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC).
* Education Department officials.
* Ward-level officers and supervisors.
* School leaders and teachers.
* Institutional and implementation partners.

Responsibilities include:

* Coordinating operational planning and implementation.
* Supporting scheduling, onboarding, and program rollout.
* Ensuring stakeholder alignment with program objectives.
* Representing LCF in meetings, reviews, workshops, and partner engagements.
* Building long-term partnerships that support program sustainability and scale.

5. Donor Management & Reporting

* Prepare high-quality quarterly and annual reports for donors and government stakeholders.
* Ensure timely reporting and compliance with donor requirements.
* Monitor financial utilization and ensure adherence to applicable guidelines.
* Maintain accurate program documentation, records, and implementation evidence.
* Develop communication and impact content, including:
* Success stories.
* Case studies.
* Testimonials.
* Photographs and field documentation.
* Quantitative and qualitative impact data.
* Support donor visits, presentations, reviews, and partner engagements.

6. Team Leadership & People Management

* Lead, mentor, and support the program team to achieve program objectives.
* Set individual and team goals aligned with organizational and program outcomes.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Identify professional development needs and facilitate coaching and learning opportunities.
* Build team capacity through on-the-job learning, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.
* Allocate responsibilities and resources effectively across project locations.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance team culture.
* Monitor team productivity and address operational challenges.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies and processes.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of high-quality talent.
* Facilitate regular team meetings, implementation reviews, and cross-functional coordination.

*Required Qualifications & Experience*

* Master's degree in *Education, Psychology, Social Work, Development Studies, Public Policy*, or a related discipline.
* *8+ years of relevant experience* in education, social sector program management, school transformation, or related fields.
* Experience in *Social Emotional Learning (SEL), teacher professional development, education system strengthening, or adolescent development* is preferred.
* Experience working with *government education departments* is highly desirable.
* Experience managing *donor-funded programs and reporting* will be an advantage.

*Required Skills & Competencies*

* Strong program and project management skills.
* Excellent training design and facilitation abilities.
* Strong stakeholder and government relationship management skills.
* Monitoring, evaluation, and data analysis capabilities.
* Excellent report writing and documentation skills.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Understanding of financial and donor compliance requirements.
* Strong planning, problem-solving, and execution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, teams, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively as required by the role.

*Who Should Apply?*

This role is ideal for professionals who:

* Are passionate about *education, adolescent development, and social impact*.
* Have strong leadership and program management experience.
* Enjoy working with schools, teachers, government stakeholders, and communities.
* Can lead teams and translate strategy into effective field implementation.
* Are comfortable working in dynamic and evolving environments.
* Are committed to creating meaningful and long-term opportunities for young people.

*Why Join Lighthouse Communities Foundation?*

At LCF, your work goes beyond a job description. You will have the opportunity to work alongside diverse stakeholders and contribute to programs that create *real, measurable change in the lives of young people*.

If you are excited about strengthening education systems, empowering adolescents, and building scalable models for social impact, we would love to hear from you.

Promote reading habits and lifelong learning among students.
Support reading initiatives, book fairs, and literacy programmes.
Assist in organizing library-related events and activities.
4. Digital Resources & Research Support
Support access to digital libraries, databases, and online learning resources.
Assist students and staff in utilizing digital research tools.
Promote ethical and responsible use of information resources.
5. Student Wellbeing & Library Engagement
Foster a welcoming, inclusive, and student-friendly library environment.
Encourage responsible library usage and positive student behaviour.
Support student wellbeing through engagement in reading and learning activities.
6. Parent Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
Support communication regarding library programmes and initiatives.
Assist in promoting reading culture among students and parents.
Build positive relationships with stakeholders through library activities.
7. Faculty Collaboration & Professional Development
Collaborate with teachers to support curriculum-related resource requirements.
Assist faculty in identifying and accessing relevant learning materials.
Participate in professional development initiatives and library improvement programmes.
8. Innovation, Research & Digital Learning
Support innovative library practices and technology integration.
Assist in developing resource collections that support research and inquiry-based learning.
Encourage students to develop critical thinking and independent research skills.

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES
Bachelor's Degree in Library Science (B.Lib.Sc.) or Library & Information Science; Master's Degree preferred.
2+ years of experience in a school, academic, or institutional library setting.
Strong knowledge of library management practices, cataloguing systems, and information services.
Demonstrated expertise in managing library resources and supporting student learning.
Ability to promote reading habits and information literacy among students.
Experience working with library management software and digital learning resources.
Strong organizational and resource management skills.
Proficiency in educational technology and digital information platforms.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
Professional, ethical, and student-centred approach to library services.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Commitment to safeguarding, inclusion, student wellbeing, and continuous professional growth.
Ability to work collaboratively with academic leaders and contribute to school-wide improvement initiatives.

At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils where we embrace all race, abilities, religions, genders, and cultures.
All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
We welcome applications from suitable qualified persons from all diverse backgrounds.
Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
